description.value:
Trigger Your Ward — the sanctioned Kindling — would be denied its ending: saved, repaired, extinguished, or rescued against the Choir's judgment

Someone is interrupting a death you were sent to guarantee. Make an immediate Strike, or attempt a damaging/destructive action, against whatever is doing the saving, with a +1 circumstance bonus — the Choir does not forgive a sentence commuted.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Answer is a homebrew reaction with no built-in engine hook -- no roll option automatically flags "this specific attack/action is this specific triggered reaction," so a bonus or exemption scoped only to that one-off use has no predicate to hang on without either an unscoped always-on toggle (which overstates the card) or a linked/expiring Effect grant, a mechanism this corpus's feat cards don't have. (Same class of gap as Steady Hand's first blocker -- a +1 circumstance bonus scoped only to this one-off triggered action has no predicate to hang on.)
